verdict.rationale: GitHub Mobile lets users start and track Copilot cloud agent tasks, so asking whether those tasks or tests run in an isolated sandbox is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence documents a sandbox or test environment, dry-run mode, or separation from production data. Related items such as GitHub Actions, the REST API and the Copilot CLI are adjacent features or building blocks, not this capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
